annotations.title: Contact verification, verify lead contact details: email, phone and website

description: Verify a lead's contact details in one call: the email (mail servers, disposable or role address, domain age), the phone number (valid, E.164 format, country, line type) and the website (redirects, destination domain age, risk signals). Give any of the three; each gets a status (ok, review or invalid) and so does the call. Offline checks and public DNS: nothing is dialled or sent. Use to qualify leads, clean a CRM or vet a prospect. Example: email=alex.morgan@stripe.com. Price $0.01/call via x402 USDC or a card key (/credits), first 25 free; failed calls free. Reads or computes only and changes nothing; each call is charged, so repeats are not free.

country.description: Two-letter country for a phone number without +code (US, GB, SE…)

website.description: Website or domain of the lead
